Sam (Product): Both ok.
Tara (Content): Fri dress only but will upload notes before tech check.
Leo (Growth): Wed tech check ok.
DeployBot: Calendar created: Tech check Wed 2024-07-10 09:00 PT, Dress Fri 2024-07-12 09:00 PT.

Sam (Product): For demo: I'll provide precomputed screenshots + a test key and a curl snippet. Add fallback slide at 07:00.

Leo (Growth): Registration form fields: Name, Email, Company, Role, Main inference pain, Interested in follow-up demo? (y/n), UTM. I'll wire routing.
Ivy (Marketing): Action list: Tara finalize abstracts by EOD tomorrow; Sam upload demo assets; Leo set promo calendar; Ivy send invites + confirm recording node. Reply when done.
Sam (Product): Demo assets uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake-demo
